title: Epik
description: This mod adds several things, such as new ores, armor, tools, and a dimension.
body: I made this mod because me and my friends felt like belonged in the game, like Crimson root stairs, it stared as a joke, but was eventually added to the mod. the mod adds some stuff like pantheine, which is a new ore and material, same with calmerite. it also adds new tools and a dimension, and biome for said dimension. it also adds my personal favorite item, which is the hammer. the hammer breaks more blocks around it than a usual pickaxe (9) but the upgraded varient does much more, unfortunally i dont know the specific number of blocks the upgraded one breaks. i also reccomend using this mod with JEI. the things you see in the images are as listed: Pantheine crystal, an Electricity And Radiation Powered Energy Generator (yes thats the full name), a compressed alliminum ally block, and the full wood (?) set. Alliminum alloy is a mid tier item that is used for a few of the mod's items. such as: Electricity And Radiation Powered Energy Generator, the hammer, and a few more. the item that adds the most things is pantheine, and by a longshot. pantheine adds 15 items alone, such as pantheine bit, pantheine crystal, pantheine crystal ingot, and more.
